Fixed-Order Evidence Report, With a Release Gate

Source: R/profile_render_report.R
profile_render_report.Rd

Assembles whatever this family's other functions have ALREADY produced into the fixed 10-section report order (see this file's header), writes every tabular piece supplied to output_dir as CSV/RDS plus an artifact manifest (relative paths and md5 content hashes), and renders one navigable HTML file. Computes nothing new except the release gate (see release_status below) and the manifest – every number in the report comes from an argument the caller already computed elsewhere in this family.

Usage

profile_render_report(
  cohort_summary = NULL,
  assumptions = NULL,
  prior_predictive = NULL,
  design = NULL,
  sampler_check = NULL,
  ppc = NULL,
  heldout = NULL,
  estimates = NULL,
  sensitivity = NULL,
  release_table = NULL,
  named_use_review = NULL,
  output_dir
)

Arguments

cohort_summary

Output of profile_summarize_cohort_eligibility, or NULL. Feeds sections 1-2.

assumptions

Output of profile_check_assumptions, or NULL. Feeds section 3, and the release gate (any status == "violated" row blocks release).

prior_predictive

Output of profile_prior_predictive, or NULL. Feeds section 3.

design

Output of profile_build_design, or NULL. Feeds section 4 ($manifest, the term dictionary).

sampler_check

Output of profile_check_sampler, or NULL. Feeds section 5, and the release gate (a status == "fail", or this argument being entirely absent, blocks release – computational status unknown is never treated as computational status fine).

ppc

Output of profile_ppc, or NULL. Feeds section 6. Any family not supplied (e.g. count_groups never computed) is reported as "Not available", never silently absent from the report's structure.

heldout

Output of profile_validate_masked, profile_validate_heldout, profile_validate_newpatient, or profile_validate_temporal, or NULL. Feeds section 7.

estimates

Output of profile_estimate, or NULL. Feeds section 8.

sensitivity

Output of profile_sensitivity, or NULL. Feeds section 9.

release_table

Output of profile_release, or NULL. Feeds sections 9-10 (the per-group decision table).

named_use_review

List or NULL. The human reviewer's recorded decision: list(approved = TRUE/FALSE, named_use = "<text>", reviewer = "<text>", date = "<text>", notes = "<text>"). NULL (default) means no review has been recorded yet – release_status is then at best "exploratory", never "approved", no matter how clean the rest of the evidence is.

output_dir

Character. Directory for the HTML report, every supplied table's CSV/RDS, and manifest.csv.

Value

A list: release_status ("blocked", "exploratory", or "approved"), release_reasons (character vector, empty only when "approved"), report_path (the written HTML file), manifest (data frame: file, relative_path, md5).
